subject: Advanced Sleep Log - (Non-Wear Detection and Nap Time) Quick Question

messages.author: bc8a377e5be3f4e3
messages.subject: Advanced Sleep Log - (Non-Wear Detection and Nap Time) Quick Question
parts:
Hello!

Is it possible to incorporate non-wear time and nap time from the advanced sleep log into the generation of results, such as physical activity or sleep metrics, using GGIR?

Here is an example demonstrating this question:

Our advanced sleep log marks this non-wear period as lasting from 5:04 to 7:52 PM. However, the non-wear detection algorithm does not detect this whole window. I was wondering if it is possible to change this window (and other non-wear windows) based on the advanced sleep log? Similarly, is it possible to mark nap periods using the advanced sleep log? 


Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Michael Melville

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Advanced Sleep Log - (Non-Wear Detection and Nap Time) Quick Question
parts:
Hi Michael,

Regarding nonwear detection:
If you use nonwear_approach = "2023" the nonwear detection should be more intuitive. Note that this is not the default yet. Our aim is to make it the default in the 3.0 release as this would affect consistency with old GGIR releases.

Regarding visualisation of self-report nonwear and nap time:
I am expecting to have a new project this summer that will pay for my time to incorporate this as an enhancement to the visualreport. Note that at the moment the self-reported nonwear and napping are not used in GGIR, all it does is archive them but the plan is to integrate them more effectively in GGIR.

Best, Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
